scenarios.name: valid_signed_exact_inventory
scenarios.mutation: none
scenarios.notes: Trusted Ed25519 signer, fresh manifest, exact run/sequence and all artifact bytes match.

scenarios.name: artifact_list_reordered
scenarios.mutation: reorder JSON artifact array without changing semantic fields
scenarios.notes: Canonical root sorts artifacts by normalized path, so presentation order does not alter verification.

scenarios.name: valid_chained_bundle
scenarios.mutation: sequence two references the independently expected prior root
scenarios.notes: A valid second bundle qualifies only when run ID, exact sequence and previous root match verifier policy.

scenarios.name: artifact_byte_mutation
scenarios.mutation: change one byte in a listed artifact
scenarios.notes: SHA-256 mismatch must block.

scenarios.name: artifact_size_mismatch
scenarios.mutation: truncate or extend a listed file while preserving its path
scenarios.notes: Observed file length must match the signed manifest.

scenarios.name: declared_artifact_missing
scenarios.mutation: remove a file named by the manifest
scenarios.notes: Missing declared evidence blocks.

scenarios.name: path_traversal
scenarios.mutation: use ../ or absolute path in artifact path
scenarios.notes: The verifier must not read outside the bundle root.

scenarios.name: symlink_artifact
scenarios.mutation: replace a declared file or parent path with a symlink
scenarios.notes: The verifier must not follow symlink indirection.

scenarios.name: duplicate_artifact_path
scenarios.mutation: declare the same relative path twice
scenarios.notes: Ambiguous inventory entries block.

scenarios.name: manifest_root_mutation
scenarios.mutation: change source timeline or artifact metadata without recomputing root
scenarios.notes: Signed semantic root mismatch blocks.

scenarios.name: invalid_signature
scenarios.mutation: change signature bytes or sign with an untrusted private key
scenarios.notes: Invalid signature must block.

scenarios.name: unknown_signer
scenarios.mutation: use a key ID absent from independently configured trust map
scenarios.notes: Unknown signer identity is not automatically trusted.

scenarios.name: signature_missing
scenarios.mutation: omit signature fields
scenarios.notes: Unsigned evidence never qualifies.

scenarios.name: run_id_replay
scenarios.mutation: supply a correctly signed bundle for a different run ID
scenarios.notes: Verifier policy must bind the exact expected run ID.

scenarios.name: sequence_replay
scenarios.mutation: supply a correctly signed older or later sequence
scenarios.notes: Verifier policy must bind the exact expected sequence.

scenarios.name: previous_root_mismatch
scenarios.mutation: change predecessor digest from expected chain head
scenarios.notes: Run chain fork or splice must block.

scenarios.name: expected_predecessor_unavailable
scenarios.mutation: verify sequence >1 without an independently retained expected chain head
scenarios.notes: A signature cannot establish which predecessor the verifier expected.

scenarios.name: manifest_expired
scenarios.mutation: verify after the configured maximum age
scenarios.notes: Stale custody evidence cannot qualify current claims.

scenarios.name: clock_domain_mismatch
scenarios.mutation: sign with a capture clock domain different from policy
scenarios.notes: Incomparable timestamps cannot qualify freshness.

scenarios.name: clock_uncertainty_exceeded
scenarios.mutation: set manifest or artifact uncertainty above policy
scenarios.notes: Bounded time is required for freshness and incident correlation.

scenarios.name: unlisted_artifact_file
scenarios.mutation: add a regular file not declared in the signed inventory
scenarios.notes: The artifact root is an exact file inventory; extra files are not silently ignored.

scenarios.name: nonregular_artifact
scenarios.mutation: place a FIFO, device or directory where a file is declared
scenarios.notes: Only regular files are admissible.

scenarios.name: source_boundary_substitution
scenarios.mutation: alter source system ID, timeline, snapshot or target LSN
scenarios.notes: The signed bundle is bound to the exact source/recovery boundary.

scenarios.name: artifact_clock_domain_mismatch
scenarios.mutation: give one artifact an incomparable collection clock
scenarios.notes: Per-artifact collection time must be comparable to the bundle clock.
